newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia signs franchise accord with Air Nostrum.
newsitem.headline: Iberia signs franchise accord with Air Nostrum.

text.p: Spanish flag carrier Iberia said on Friday it had signed a franchise agreement with Spanish private regional airline Air Nostrum.
"This is the first franchise agreement in the airline sector in Spain but without doubt there will be many more in the future," Xabier de Irala, chairman of Iberia, said at a press conference.
Irala said the agreement had been fixed for five years and may be extended thereafter.
Under the agreement, Iberia, its 33-percent owned affiliate Aviaco, and Air Nostrum will coordinate flight timetables and share marketing systems and techniques.
Irala said the agreement did not involve any exchange of capital and would be fully effective after a transition period of three months.
Air Nostrum's network covers 20 national destinations and one international, Nice. It offers more than 400 flights each week.
